description.value: Cardero Cafe is a neighbourhood cafe situated at 1016 Cardero Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from the Stanley Park seawall cycling route. OSM records it as a standalone building with both vegan and vegetarian menu options. Its location on a quiet residential street makes it a natural stop for cyclists riding the seawall or exploring the West End.

The fetched website content returned only Instagram's generic login wall pages — no Cardero Cafe-specific content was accessible — so OSM tags are the sole evidence source. The diet tags are used to confirm vegetarian/vegan options; all other amenity fields remain null due to insufficient evidence.
